# Downloaded art and licensing

Lantern and WaterBottle were obtained from KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets,
commit 15cd02d304e54cb42a4db4eefe719f76190f4b68.

- Lantern: Microsoft (2017), original version by sbtron. CC0-1.0.
- WaterBottle: Microsoft (2017), credited as Public. CC0-1.0.

License: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/legalcode

Source legal declarations:
https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets/blob/15cd02d304e54cb42a4db4eefe719f76190f4b68/Models/Lantern/README.md
https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets/blob/15cd02d304e54cb42a4db4eefe719f76190f4b68/Models/WaterBottle/README.md

The BRM files contain converted geometry and resized base-color images. UVs
are preserved; normal, emissive and metal/roughness maps are not used by this
renderer. Exact URLs, source hashes and conversion hashes are in sources.json.
The converter is tools/convert_gltf.py. No third-party code was imported.

All other geometry, character animation and procedural surface materials are
original work created for this project. These imported props improve scene
art; they do not replace the full renderer or constitute photorealistic art.

## CesiumMilkTruck

CesiumMilkTruck, copyright 2017 Cesium, from the same pinned Khronos collection.
Licensed under **Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International**:
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

Source and legal declaration:
https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets/blob/15cd02d304e54cb42a4db4eefe719f76190f4b68/Models/CesiumMilkTruck/README.md

Converted coordinates, normalized the model, resized base-color images to
256 pixels, preserved UVs and packed it into BRM1. It is static scenery here.
Source and derivative hashes are recorded in sources.json. The full CC-BY-4.0
license and the collection's Cesium trademark notice accompany this file.
Cesium's name/logo identifies the original asset; no endorsement is implied.
